program.architecturalLanguage: architecture behaves robotically through functional test infrastructure, adaptive skins, replaceable modules, active docking, responsive structures, and exterior machine circulation without figurative robot ornament

buildings.name: Corpus Nexus
buildings.subtitle: Embodied Intelligence and Humanoid Robotics Institute
buildings.purpose: Whole-body embodied AI, humanoid locomotion, mobile manipulation, robot foundation models, and sim-to-real learning
buildings.exteriorMotif: seven rotated slabs around an inclined spine and articulated titanium exoskeleton above hostile urban terrain
buildings.operationalMovement: load-transfer signals, camera booms, terrace maintenance cranes, and vertical-locomotion trials

buildings.name: Tactus Hall
buildings.subtitle: Robotic Skin, Dexterity and Manipulation Laboratory
buildings.purpose: Robotic hands, multimodal tactile sensing, artificial skin, compliant grasping, in-hand manipulation, and tool use
buildings.exteriorMotif: a long tapered instrument clad in responsive ceramic sensor tiles above an articulated twenty-four-support canopy
buildings.operationalMovement: contact-event light constellations, iris manipulators, and load-adjusting canopy supports

buildings.name: Myomer Pavilion
buildings.subtitle: Soft Robotics, Artificial Muscle and Adaptive Morphology Centre
buildings.purpose: Pneumatic and hydraulic robots, artificial muscles, variable-stiffness structures, self-healing elastomers, and continuum manipulators
buildings.exteriorMotif: serpentine translucent membrane lobes, vascular fluid channels, self-repair scars, and variable-stiffness arches
buildings.operationalMovement: slow pneumatic breathing, load-responsive muscle bundles, and reconfigurable outdoor arches

buildings.name: Murmuration Array
buildings.subtitle: Swarm Robotics and Collective Autonomy Complex
buildings.purpose: Decentralized coordination, aerial and terrestrial swarms, collective mapping, emergent construction, and distributed sensing
buildings.exteriorMotif: six equal hexagonal docking towers around an open high-tension-mesh swarm enclosure and Consensus Needle
buildings.operationalMovement: coordinated drone constellations, shifting machine-readable landmarks, and mobile sensor pods

buildings.name: Symbiont Conservatory
buildings.subtitle: Biohybrid and Living Robotics Laboratory
buildings.purpose: Living muscle, neurons, responsive tissues, biological actuators, organism-machine interfaces, and cultivated robots
buildings.exteriorMotif: three lens pavilions nested under a branching transparent shell with culture-media tubes and biosafety basins
buildings.operationalMovement: fluid-front indicators, frame-crawling maintenance robots, incubator lanterns, and aquatic monitors

buildings.name: Magnetotaxis Vault
buildings.subtitle: Medical Micro- and Nanorobotics Research Centre
buildings.purpose: Magnetic and acoustic microrobots, targeted delivery, microscale manipulation, soft medical robots, and confined-fluid navigation
buildings.exteriorMotif: a buried black dome surrounded by six monumental copper-banded field arches and four acoustic pylons
buildings.operationalMovement: drifting field geometry, responsive-liquid calibration, and acoustic interference displays

buildings.name: Avatar Spine
buildings.subtitle: Telepresence, Haptics and Robotic Embodiment Institute
buildings.purpose: Remote robotic avatars, full-body teleoperation, haptic feedback, exoskeleton control, shared autonomy, and remote science
buildings.exteriorMotif: paired leaning dark and translucent towers linked under tension by three sensor-lattice bridges
buildings.operationalMovement: Echo Armature posture mirroring, synchronized facade silhouettes, and bridge inspection robots

buildings.name: Terminus Range
buildings.subtitle: Extreme-Environment and Disaster Robotics Facility
buildings.purpose: Search-and-rescue, subterranean, deep-sea, polar, planetary, and autonomous inspection robotics
buildings.exteriorMotif: four scarred armoured hangars around a rearrangeable Failure Canyon and compressed hostile terrain
buildings.operationalMovement: test-crane traversal, hazard boundaries, wash-down frames, and autonomous endurance routes

buildings.name: Autopoiesis Yard
buildings.subtitle: Autonomous Construction and Robotic Fabrication Hall
buildings.purpose: Robotic assembly, large-scale additive manufacturing, autonomous building, voxel construction, and self-climbing machines
buildings.exteriorMotif: an open fabrication hall with sliding space-frame roof, interchangeable facade bays, gantries, and unfinished prototypes
buildings.operationalMovement: bridge-gantry fabrication, rail carriers, climbing maintenance robots, and replaceable building bays

buildings.name: Palingenesis Works
buildings.subtitle: Modular, Evolutionary and Self-Repairing Robotics Laboratory
buildings.purpose: Self-reconfiguring robots, modular bodies, autonomous repair, machine ecology, and long-duration adaptive systems
buildings.exteriorMotif: twelve mismatched annular modules, exposed scar plates, a circular service rail, Parts Trees, and central sorting tower
buildings.operationalMovement: facade-module servicing, component exchange, repair-nest traffic, and autonomous parts redistribution

program.operationalRule: movement replaces ornament; every animated element represents testing, calibration, logistics, maintenance, sensing, or structural response
